title: Mere Hussain ke aabad ghar ko loot liya
body:
MERE HUSSAIN KE ABAAD GHAR KO LOOT LIYA
Pala tha wo meri aaghosh mein muraado se
Badan pe aaj ye unnees-sau (1900) hai zakhm uske
Usi ke halq pe khanjar mai dekhungi kaise
<<MINI>>
Fazaye karbobala mein thi Fatima ki sada
<<DIVIDER>>
Wo hum Shabihe payambar jawaa’n Ali Akber
Jo tha Hussain ke dil ka sukoon Noor-e-Nazar
Wo khaake barchhi ka phal kargaya jahan se safar
<<MINI>>
Fazaye karbobala mein thi Fatima ki sada
<<DIVIDER>>
Rabab kaise bhulaye wo khoo’n bhara manzar
Tha halq jiska sitamgar ke teerki zadd par
Nisar dono jahaa’n uske khushk honto’n par
<<MINI>>
Fazaye karbobala mein thi Fatima ki sada
<<DIVIDER>>
Bala ke dasht mein kaisi ajeeb thi shaadi
Abhi gaya tha abhi laash aayi dulha ki
Rida bhi chhingayi dulhan ki maang bhi ujdi
<<MINI>>
Fazaye karbobala mein thi Fatima ki sada
<<DIVIDER>>
Nabi ki aal ke parde ka jo muhafiz tha
Katake baazuo ko sogaya labe dariya
Haram aseer huwe chhingayi saro’n se rida
<<MINI>>
Fazaye karbobala mein thi Fatima ki sada
<<DIVIDER>>
Wo run se Aon-o-Mohammed ke aye jab lashe
Tha khak-o-khoon mein ghalta wo laal Zainab ke
Ye dagh dil pe liye maa jeeye to kaise jeeye
<<MINI>>
Fazaye karbobala mein thi Fatima ki sada
<<DIVIDER>>
Qadam qadam pa wo sadme uthaya laal mera
Kabhi jawaa’n ka kabhi bezubaa’n ka daagh mila
Kabhi tarayi pe bedast bhai ko dekha
<<MINI>>
Fazaye karbobala mein thi Fatima ki sada
<<DIVIDER>>
Wo waqt-e-asr talak lut chuka tha jiska ghar
Nahi tha koi bhi humdum na tha koi yaawar
Har ek simt se teer-o-sina chale uspar
<<MINI>>
Fazaye karbobala mein thi Fatima ki sada
<<DIVIDER>>
Zubaa’n pe tha ye Mohammed ka mai nawasa hoon
Aye kalma-goyo tumhara mai kya bigaada hoon
Mai teen roz ka bhooka hoon aur pyaasa hoon
<<MINI>>
Fazaye karbobala mein thi Fatima ki sada
<<DIVIDER>>
Sitam ki karbobala mein chali ajab aandhi
Chala jo halq pe khanjar zamee’n larazne lagi
Falak pe karte the hoor-o-malayeka zaari
<<MINI>>
Fazaye karbobala mein thi Fatima ki sada
<<DIVIDER>>
Sohail karbobala ki ye daastaa’n sunkar
Gham-e-Hussain mein dooba huwa hai har manzar
Lahoo ke aansoo bahate hai sab ke qalb-o-jigar
<<MINI>>
